structured_output.world_model: Time is about 0.1 s fixed plus steps times per-step cost, with a pixel-proportional compute part and a bandwidth part. The accuracy dial is about 0.8-1.5 s/pp. Early 20 px steps are cheap in accuracy. Late freezes are free only once learning has finished. Rebuild noise is about ±0.03 s in time and about ±0.15 pp in the 3-seed mean. The tip is 5.02 s at 0.7534, and the 3-seed accuracy sits at the threshold. Any further cut makes the seeds 0-2 gate (≥0.753) a coin flip, so the 'status' result is dominated by noise.

forecasts.reason: Another 12 early steps save about 0.1 s and cost about 0.05-0.1 pp, and that is within noise. The seeds 0-2 gate is marginal.
Narrowing group 3 to 448 saves about 3% of time and costs about 0.15-0.3 pp. That is near the dial rate, so it is a wash.
Removing a conv from the stem group cuts capacity at 15x15 and likely loses more than 0.26 pp. E051 showed that stem surgery loses more than it saves.
The 24 px phase moves to 20 px. This saves about 0.05 s for about 0.1 pp, so it is neutral within noise.
Time is unchanged. The LS effect is small and probably flat. A slight gain is possible, but the earlier LS-to-0 result was negative.

cruxes: Is the early-step dose curve linear beyond 225 steps, or is there a cliff? This decides I099 and I102.
What is the true rebuild SD of the 3-seed gate? It decides whether any further cut can pass seeds 0-2 ≥0.753.
Is the dial near 0.77 s/pp for width cuts too, or is it near 1.4 s/pp? This decides I100.
